result.instructions: Tools for OCR.space, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Read the text from this receipt photo: https://example.com/receipt.jpg"; "Extract the table from this scanned invoice PDF as Markdown with engine 3."; "Make a searchable PDF from this scanned contract URL.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OCR.space data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ocrspace_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ocrspace_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ocrspace_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ocrspace_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ocrspace_ocr_url
tools.title: OCR an image or PDF from a URL
tools.description: Extract text from an image or PDF at a public https URL with OCR.space (POST /parse/image). Returns the text per page (a PDF gives one entry per page; the free plan reads the first 3 pages and files up to 1 MB). Uses one request of your OCR.space quota (free key: 25,000 requests per month and 500 requests per day). Options: language, engine (1-3), is_table (line-by-line text for tables, receipts, invoices), detect_orientation, scale (upscale low-resolution scans), include_overlay (word coordinates; slower).

url.description: Public https URL of the image or PDF (the file must be reachable without login and served with an image/* or application/pdf content type).

language.description: Document language, a 3-letter code such as eng, ger, fre, spa, chs (see ocrspace_list_languages). Default eng. 'auto' works with engine 2 and 3 only.

engine.description: OCR engine 1, 2 or 3. Default 2 (best all-round). 3 = highest accuracy, handwriting, tables as Markdown, 200+ languages, slower, and has its own smaller quota. 1 = fastest but deprecated.

filetype.description: Force the file type when the URL's content type is wrong (default: detected).

is_table.description: Return text line by line, best for tables, receipts and invoices.

detect_orientation.description: Auto-rotate the image; the page's text_orientation reports the rotation.

scale.description: Upscale internally; helps low-resolution PDF scans.

include_overlay.description: Also return word coordinates (left/top/width/height in pixels), capped at 1000 words.

annotations.title: OCR an image or PDF from a URL

tools.name: ocrspace_ocr_base64
tools.title: OCR a base64-encoded image or PDF
tools.description: Extract text from a small file passed as base64 (POST /parse/image with base64Image). Up to 1,400,000 base64 characters (about 1 MB, the free plan's file limit); use ocrspace_ocr_url for bigger files. Pass either a full data URI (data:image/png;base64,...) or the raw base64 plus mime_type. Uses one request of your OCR.space quota (free key: 25,000 requests per month and 500 requests per day). Options as in ocrspace_ocr_url.

image_base64.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI, or raw base64 together with mime_type). Whitespace and newlines are removed.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file; required when image_base64 has no data: prefix.

language.description: Document language, a 3-letter code such as eng, ger, fre, spa, chs (see ocrspace_list_languages). Default eng. 'auto' works with engine 2 and 3 only.

engine.description: OCR engine 1, 2 or 3. Default 2 (best all-round). 3 = highest accuracy, handwriting, tables as Markdown, 200+ languages, slower, and has its own smaller quota. 1 = fastest but deprecated.

filetype.description: Force the file type when the URL's content type is wrong (default: detected).

is_table.description: Return text line by line, best for tables, receipts and invoices.

detect_orientation.description: Auto-rotate the image; the page's text_orientation reports the rotation.

scale.description: Upscale internally; helps low-resolution PDF scans.

include_overlay.description: Also return word coordinates, capped at 1000 words.

annotations.title: OCR a base64-encoded image or PDF

tools.name: ocrspace_create_searchable_pdf
tools.title: Create a searchable PDF from a URL
tools.description: Run OCR on a public https image/PDF URL and have OCR.space build a searchable PDF (a copy of the file with a text layer). Returns searchable_pdf_url, a download link that expires after one hour, plus the recognized text. The free plan adds a 'Generated by OCR.space' watermark. Engine 3 cannot make searchable PDFs, so only engine 1 or 2 is accepted (default 2). Uses one request of your OCR.space quota (free key: 25,000 requests per month and 500 requests per day).

url.description: Public https URL of the image or PDF.

language.description: Document language, a 3-letter code such as eng, ger, fre, spa, chs (see ocrspace_list_languages). Default eng. 'auto' works with engine 2 and 3 only.

engine.description: OCR engine 1 or 2 (default 2); engine 3 does not create searchable PDFs.

filetype.description: Force the file type when the URL's content type is wrong (default: detected).

hide_text_layer.description: Hide the text layer (default false = visible text layer). The text layer exists either way.

annotations.title: Create a searchable PDF from a URL

tools.name: ocrspace_list_languages
tools.title: List OCR languages, engines and limits
tools.description: Reference (no request to OCR.space, no quota used): the documented language codes for the language option, what OCR engines 1, 2 and 3 do, and the free-plan limits.

annotations.title: List OCR languages, engines and limits
